question: Who was the acting President of Myanmar who passed away in August 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**U Myint Swe**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Myanmar’s Acting President U Myint Swe Passes Away at 74.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**U Myint Swe**, acting **President of Myanmar**, passed away at the age of **74** in **Nay Pyi Taw**.

 
 
• 
 
He had been diagnosed with **Parkinson’s Disease** and other **neurological conditions**.

 
 
• 
 
He had been on **medical leave since July 2024**.

 
 
• 
 
**Duties were transferred** to **Senior General Min Aung Hlaing** during his leave.

 
 
• 
 
U Myint Swe was sworn in as **Vice President** in **March 2016**.

 
 
• 
 
Became **acting president** in **February 2021** after **President U Win Myint** was **detained**.

 
 
• 
 
He declared a **state of emergency** and transferred power to **Min Aung Hlaing**.
